newsitem.title: JAPAN: LTCB leaves April long-term prime rate unchanged.
newsitem.headline: LTCB leaves April long-term prime rate unchanged.

text.p: The Long-term Credit Bank of Japan Ltd (LTCB) said on Wednesday it would leave its long-term prime lending rate for April unchanged at 2.5 percent.
The prime rate is applied to loans of one year and longer to the long-term credit bank's most creditworthy clients.
The long-term prime rate was last cut in December to a record low 2.5 percent from 2.7 percent in November.
LTCB also said it will leave the coupon rate on its April five-year debentures, sold to institutional investors, unchanged from the March issue at 1.9 percent.
